from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]

    line_color = None
    for color, _ in counts.most_common():
        if color != background:
            line_color = color
            break

    rows = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r].count(line_color) > w // 2]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == line_color for r in range(h)) > h // 2]

    out = []
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            corners = [grid[rows[i]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i]][cols[j + 1]],
                       grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j + 1]]]
            if corners[0] != line_color and corners[0] != background and all(v == corners[0] for v in corners):
                row.append(corners[0])
            else:
                row.append(background)
        out.append(row)
    return out

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line_color = counts.most_common(2)[1][0]

    rows = [r for r in range(h)
            if sum(v == line_color for v in grid[r]) > w // 2]
    cols = [c for c in range(w)
            if sum(grid[r][c] == line_color for r in range(h)) > h // 2]

    out = []
    for r in range(len(rows) - 1):
        out_row = []
        for c in range(len(cols) - 1):
            corners = [
                grid[rows[r]][cols[c]],
                grid[rows[r]][cols[c + 1]],
                grid[rows[r + 1]][cols[c]],
                grid[rows[r + 1]][cols[c + 1]],
            ]
            marker = corners[0]
            if marker != background and marker != line_color and all(x == marker for x in corners):
                out_row.append(marker)
            else:
                out_row.append(background)
        out.append(out_row)

    nonempty = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(out)
                for c, value in enumerate(row) if value != background]
    if not nonempty:
        return [[background]]
    r0 = min(r for r, _ in nonempty)
    r1 = max(r for r, _ in nonempty)
    c0 = min(c for _, c in nonempty)
    c1 = max(c for _, c in nonempty)
    return [row[c0:c1 + 1] for row in out[r0:r1 + 1]]
